name: sada-iraq
description: صدى العراق — Railway Node.js service with Netlify compatibility

scripts.preflight: node --check server.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const f of ['server.js','index.html','package.json','config.json']) if(!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing required root file: '+f); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('config.json','utf8')); const s=fs.readFileSync('server.js','utf8'); if(String(p.version).split('.').slice(0,2).join('.')!==String(c.version)) throw new Error('package/config version mismatch'); if(String(p.buildId)!==String(c.buildId)||!s.includes(p.buildId)) throw new Error('release buildId mismatch'); console.log('PASS: deploy preflight checks.');"
